curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a tranquil family farmhouse becomes the stage for an endless siege of terror, will either friend survive the night?
curatedMovie.description: Best friends Marie and Alexia head to an isolated countryside farmhouse for a peaceful weekend with Alexia's parents, but their quiet retreat collapses into an unrelenting night of terror.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, heavy, and intensely suspenseful; an immersive horror thriller set in isolated countryside dread.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Its secluded-farmhouse setup gives this horror thriller a focused overnight premise that turns a friendly visit into sustained tension.
